links.comparator_used: Baseline ChatGPT and Gemini responses without guideline retrieval (model knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Accuracy, guideline adherence and safety of LLM decision support for acute ENT emergencies, rated by five blinded otolaryngologists on a nine-domain rubric
links.effect: Significant improvement in diagnostic accuracy, diagnostic workup quality, management planning, referral appropriateness and guideline adherence; reduced misleading recommendations; modestly decreased overtreatment; overtesting rates unchanged. No numeric values given in the abstract.
links.quote: Compared with baseline models, RAG-enabled models demonstrated significantly improved diagnostic accuracy, diagnostic workup quality, management planning, referral appropriateness, and guideline adherence.

design_hint: retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounding with clinical practice guidelines
